_comment: Synthesized (Phase 20.5) — Gemini batchEmbedContents 400 envelope. HAND-WRITTEN IN FULL, including the details[] entry: no live response backs this file. Its only job is the adapter's key-redaction test, for which the message deliberately embeds a key-shaped string (AIzaSy...) that Google's real INVALID_ARGUMENT text does not echo back. For a GENUINE Gemini 400 envelope see recorded/error_400_unknown_field.json, which the probe in scripts/record_gemini_embeddings_fixtures.exs writes from a live response and which carries a google.rpc.BadRequest details entry rather than the google.rpc.ErrorInfo one invented here. The :invalid_request and google_status assertions run against that recorded file; this one is asserted only for redaction.
